{{Top|leg}}
A '''crafts-guild''' was part of a [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] hive. Each hive maintained a crafts-guild which was dedicated to building [[Starship/Legends|starships]] using Surronian technology. Members of a crafts-guild were known as [[guildmember]]s, and young aspirants to join the guild were known as [[guild-apprentice]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
